rollups.text: Joanna completed and printed her first full screenplay, a drama-romance, on 2022-01-21. By 2022-01-23 she planned to submit it to film festivals; by 2022-02-07 it had been submitted and was on her mind daily. While waiting, she began another script by 2022-02-25. She later described receiving a generic rejection from a major company on 2022-06-03, and submitted a recent screenplay to a film contest on 2022-06-24. By 2022-10-21 she had received another production-company rejection for a contest submission, but intended to keep going. Elapsed from finishing the first screenplay to the reported contest-related rejection: about 9 months.

Joanna began writing a book by 2022-07-10, after her movie work went well; she said it might be her first book publication and described its emotional story as exploring loss, redemption, and forgiveness. She shared it with her writers group during the week of 2022-08-15–2022-08-22 and received encouraging feedback. During the week of 2022-09-26–2022-10-02, after many late nights and edits, she finished the book. Elapsed from first reported book-writing to completion: about 3 months.

Joanna’s laptop crashed during the week of 2022-09-05–2022-09-11, destroying all her writing work with nothing recoverable. By 2022-09-14 she had bought an external drive to back up future writing and said she did not want to experience another loss like that. Elapsed from crash period to reported backup solution: within about 9 days.

Joanna and her writers group were making progress on “Finding Home,” a script about a girl seeking her true home, by 2022-04-21; Joanna found the work rewarding and emotional. On 2022-05-20 she reported completing a third writing project, a personal story about loss, identity, and connection, which she had held onto for a long time before finding the courage to write. The records do not establish whether this completed project was “Finding Home.”

rollups.text: Joanna researched a new movie idea on a road trip to Woodhaven on 2022-07-08, exploring the town and finding a 1900s book of local stories and sketches. By 2022-07-10, the town’s history had given her ideas for a different script. On 2022-11-11, she said she was filming her own movie based on her road-trip script; she was excited to be on set, and an actor told her she loved the script. Elapsed from the research trip to filming: about 4 months.

rollups.text: Joanna set up meetings with movie producers by 2022-11-04, and reported that they went well: she confidently discussed her script and vision, producers were interested, and they liked the self-discovery elements. Joanna said on 2022-10-23 that a movie script she contributed to had been shown on the big screen for the first time that day, and that it was the third time one of her script contributions had been shown on the big screen. She had also described seeing her words come alive on screen on 2022-06-04. The records therefore document three screen appearances by 2022-10-23, but do not give dates for all three.

Joanna reported two screenplay-related rejection setbacks: a generic rejection from a major company by 2022-06-03, and another production-company rejection for a project sent to a film contest by 2022-10-21. She said she would continue working after both.
